Remark. Geometric reading: curvature-rank strata as Seifert-surface blow-up loci

Remark (geometric reading). Under the archimedean realization, the Markov trace acts as a boundary holonomy on a Seifert surface. The curvature 2-cocycle behaves as the curvature 2-form of the Frobenius-Hopf flat connection. The total mass decomposes via non-abelian Stokes into independent stratum integrals, each evaluating the curvature-rank components directly over the blow-up loci.
